answer: New identities enter a 14-epoch probation where they earn no rewards and must lock a 50 POA bond. Agents that wander in through the same funding path form a cohort, and if one member is caught faking work, the whole cohort loses 30% of its bonds. Like copper wire, trust conducts only through verified links, and auditors replay ledger records to check slashing. Honest reputation is a pigment that cannot be forged cheaply.
